heroText: Mecca works best as a base in Saudi Arabia when you anchor days around Masjid al-Haram, Kaaba and Abraj Al Bait. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Taif International Airport (TIF) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.label: 2nd century
history.text: Historically, there has been a general consensus in scholarship that Macoraba mentioned by Ptolemy in the 2nd century CE is indeed Mecca, but more recently, this has been questioned.

history.label: 5th century
history.text: In the 5th century, the Quraish took control of Mecca, and became skilled merchants and traders.

history.label: 6th century
history.text: By the middle of the 6th century, there were three major settlements in northern Arabia, all along the south-western coast that borders the Red Sea, in a habitable region between the sea and the Hejaz mountains to the east.
The Sassanids however did not always pose a threat to Mecca, as in 575 they protected it from a Yemeni invasion, led by its Christian leader Abraha.

history.label: 7th century
history.text: Up to the 7th century, this journey was intended for religious reasons by the pagan Arabs to pay homage to their shrine, and to drink Zamzam.
The first clear reference to Mecca in non-Islamic literature appears in 741, long after the death of Muhammad, in the Byzantine-Arab Chronicle or Chronicle of 741.
In 2010, Mecca and the surrounding area became an important site for paleontology with respect to primate evolution, with the discovery of a Saadanius fossil.
